card1.title: Our Mission:
card1.text1_2: , we are passionate about making the world of bouldering more accessible, exciting, and community-driven.
card1.text2: Our mission is to connect climbers with the best competitions, allowing them to register, stay informed, and track their progress all in one place.
card1.text3: Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting, we aim to provide a platform that fosters growth, challenges, and unforgettable experiences.

card2.title: Discover and Compete:
card2.text1: Bouldering is more than just a sport; it's a way to test your limits and push past boundaries.
card2.text2_1: Our platform allows you to easily find upcoming competitions and
card2.text2_2: that match your skill level and passion.
card2.text3: Stay up-to-date on local and global bouldering events and never miss an opportunity to compete, challenge yourself, and meet others who share your love for climbing.

card3.title: Explore Boulder Halls:
card3.text1: We understand that finding the right training environment is essential to improving your climbing skills.
card3.text2_1: That's why we offer an extensive overview offer
card3.text2_2: across the area, helping you find the perfect place to train, meet other climbers, and prepare for your next competition.
card3.text3: Whether you're looking for a beginner-friendly space or a gym with challenging routes, we've got you covered.

policy1.title: 1. Introduction
policy1.text1: This Privacy Policy explains which personal data we collect when you use the website bouldermeet.com, for which purposes, on what legal basis, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
policy1.text2: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously and process it exclusively in accordance with the GDPR and this document.

policy3.title: 3. Hosting and Technical Infrastructure
policy3.text3: Data processing takes place exclusively within the EU.
policy3.text4: The application runs in Docker containers; the backend is developed in a Next.js / PayloadCMS environment and executed exclusively on our servers.
policy3.text5: There is no data transfer to Google or third parties.

policy4.title: 4. Data We Collect
policy4.text: When you register, we collect and process the following data:

text1_0.text1_6: Password (hashed and never stored in plain text)

policy4.text1: This data is required so users can:

text1_1.text1_4: view their event and result history

policy4.text2: When you visit our website, our server automatically stores minimal technical data in so-called server log files, including:

text2_1.text2_2: Date and time of the request

policy4.text3: These logs are used solely for system security, abuse prevention, and technical diagnostics.

policy5.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
policy5.text1: We use only one functional, strictly necessary cookie:

cookie.value2: Stores the user’s selected language and ensures the website is displayed in the correct locale

policy5.text2_2: We do not use analytics tools.
policy5.text2_3: We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Matomo, or any other tracking technologies.
policy5.text2_4: All website functionalities are available without the use of third-party or tracking cookies.

policy6.text1: We process your data exclusively for the following purposes:

text2.text2_4: Providing access to personal event history

policy6.text3: We do not process data for marketing purposes and do not send newsletters.
